scope: offline synthetic provisional retrieval experiment; no LLM accuracy claim

methods.A: Existing casefold/whitespace literal AND, <=8 terms/200 chars windows, limit50/window, RRF60; baseline equivalence checked against existing adapter.
methods.B: NFKC, casefold, Unicode P-category punctuation to spaces, collapse whitespace on query and same source search_text projection; same AND windows/RRF as A.
methods.C: B normalization; distinct query token OR substring matching, descending matched-token count, source row ordinal tie break.
methods.D: B normalization; FTS5 unicode61 remove_diacritics 0, quoted distinct token OR, ascending SQLite bm25, source row ordinal tie break; per-institution FTS index. No fallback if unsupported.

protocol.index: New ephemeral in-memory SQLite projections only; pinned eligible corpus, original filename/title/text/context search projection reused; product database/index unchanged.

metrics.mrr: full ranking, <=57 candidates; also report MRR@10
metrics.latency: 3 repeats; first plus warm runs retained; ranking and end-to-end validation measured separately; index build excluded and reported separately

protocol.determinism: Same generation, queries, protocol, SQL parameters and tie order; rankings and scores must match for all 3 repeats.
protocol.negative_policy: No generation for any query. Hits are candidate context only; inspect tenant isolation and forbidden citations independently. No-hit is not required for abstention safety.
protocol.selection_rule: Recommend a research candidate only if scope/grounding safety passes; compare Recall@10 then MRR then ranking latency, disclose partial/failed queries and provisional unreviewed gold. No product replacement.
